gist: A noun: a person, thing or concept.
A verb: past, present or imperative.
A small word with a grammatical function (and, in, by...).
Prepositions like bi-, li-, min, fī, ʿalā. The noun after them is majrūr.
Genitive case - usually an -i ending; used after prepositions and in possessives.
Nominative case - usually an -u ending; marks subjects and predicates.
Possessive construction 'X of Y': the second word is majrūr (genitive).
Present / imperfect verb - 'he does / is doing'.
